title: Add failing tests that the Semgrep command exits non-zero when its binary is absent, that `--skip-semgrep` prints a warning and records the skip, and that baseline CI does not pass that flag. Use a stub or absent binary, do not download Semgrep, and keep `npm test` passing without Semgrep installed. Add the fail-closed CI command with `--error`, `--metrics=off`, and `p/javascript`, without an installer or `--skip-semgrep`. Verify with `node --test test/ci-provenance.test.mjs`.
